thread:
maria: Quick ask — can we get a one-page FAQ/sell-card that helps AE/SEs close security-minded orgs? Need clear bullets on Private vs Dedicated + SLA and KMS/SCALABILITY callouts. Short and field-ready.

alex: +1. keep it scannable: 3 headers max, quick checklist, and a tiny decision flow.

jamal: I can draft the technical bullets. I'll include: network isolation (VPC peering), customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), audit logs, and on-prem option.

jen: Will design a vertical card for field use — do we want two column (feature vs customer value) or single column checklist?

samir: Two-column works for slides; for email attach single column. Let's make master single column so it adapts.

leo: I can do a rapid mock by EOD tomorrow. Need copy by noon.

patrick: Sales asks: include a one-liner for price/commit expectations (Dedicated reserved capacity) and a fallback story for hosted API during spikes. Also add routing hint: "inbound -> /sales/enterprise -> tag:deploy-mode" so RevOps can auto-route.

maria: Good call. Add a tiny benchmark stat: median p95 latency for dedicated vs hosted on standard prompt. Jamal can that be a small stat?

jamal: I can pull a conservative number: p95 latency Dedicated = ~150ms, Hosted baseline = ~210ms (for 2k token median). Will label as "example workload — results vary".

jen: Copy for security callouts: short bullets: "Data residency & VPC", "Customer KMS for model inputs/outputs", "Audit & SIEM integrations", "SLA-backed latency & uptime tiers" — ok to shorten?

maria: Perfect. Also include a single line about fallbacks: "Automatic model fallback & regional routing to maintain availability" — keeps reliability story in front.

leo: Mock v1 attached (link): https://drive.example/rd/one-pager-mock-v1 — layout is single column with collapsible variants for field.

patrick: Nice. For inbound routing, RevOps needs the form field keys. Suggest: product_interest=deploy-mode, compliance=security, sla_tier=desired. I'll add to Confluence and tag SRE.

ops-bot: checklist created: ticket #MK-1427 one-pager draft -> jamal (tech copy) + leo (design) + jen (UX review). Due: 1716724800 (Fri 5 PM).

maria: Great. Next steps: jamal to drop draft by tomorrow noon, leo to mock by EOD, jen to review Friday morning, I'll prep a 2-slide webinar blurb referencing the one-pager for field enablement.

jamal: Draft below (short):
```
Private: Full customer control — VPC-isolated control plane, option for on-prem deployment, customer-managed KMS/HSM, max data residency and auditability. Ideal for regulated workloads.

Dedicated: Shared control plane w/ isolated GPU pools — SLA-backed throughput and latency, predictable cost via reserved capacity, faster onboarding than on-prem. Good for high-volume apps needing predictability.

Hosted: Fastest time-to-value, continuous updates, cost-efficient for bursty workloads. Works with automatic fallback and model routing.

Key security features: VPC peering, TLS+mutual auth, KMS integration, audit logs + SIEM hooks, SOC2/ISO notes.

When to pick: If security+data controls are mandatory -> Private. If predictability+throughput matters -> Dedicated. If speed-to-market & cost are priorities -> Hosted.
```

jen: Love it — I'll trim language to be more customer-facing and remove the wordy bits.

leo: I'll swap one icon for KMS/HSM and add a small SLA badge. Will post v2 around 1716680400 (tomorrow evening).

patrick: FYI: Sales playbook bit: add a 15s elevator pitch: "Pick Dedicated for predictable, SLA-backed inference; choose Private when regulatory controls are non-negotiable." Keep it in the card.

maria: Perfect. Also planning a short webinar slot where we show a benchmark run and the decision flow. Tentative webinar headline: "Choosing an inference deployment that meets security and SLA needs" — I'll draft synposis.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: review call Friday 1716728400.

maria: Thanks team — this feels field-ready. I'll consolidate assets in the marketing drive and ping RevOps when final. :thumbsup:
